_comment: Generated by scripts/check-no-loopback-self-fetch.mjs --emit-inventory, then classified by hand. Every fetch sink in src/ whose destination the AST cannot statically decide must appear here exactly once. "self-fetch" is NOT a valid classification — it is the architecture the gate bans — and EVERY accepted classification requires a non-empty "justification", so a classification on its own is never a way past the gate. WARNING: --emit-inventory REGENERATES, it does not merge: it returns every entry as UNCLASSIFIED with no justification and drops _comment/_classifications, so redirecting it over this file destroys all the hand-written prose while leaving the sink keys byte-identical. Emit to a scratch file and port entries across. Note on terminology: the two "retired" route prefixes the gate still bans (/api/sync-orchestrator, /api/automation-libraries) are STILL MOUNTED and still serving — they are platform-global process state behind requirePlatformAdmin, so no public page has a legitimate reason to call them. A third prefix, /api/sync-central, left this ban in PR3: it is now an ordinary authenticated tenant API (authMiddleware + the tenant kill switch), so it is no longer banned here.

_classifications.external-provider: Calls a third-party API. The destination host is external to this app. Requires a written justification — the AST could not decide the destination, which is why the sink is here at all.
_classifications.external-provider-wrapper: Called through a typeof-fetch alias, so the URL arrives at runtime and the AST proves nothing. Requires a written justification.
_classifications.browser-embedded: JavaScript inside a server-rendered template, executed by the browser with an origin and session cookie. Requires a written justification — the gate cannot prove a template string is browser-executed.

sinks.justification: Browser JavaScript inside a server-rendered HTML template. It executes in the user agent, which has an origin and a session cookie, so it is a normal same-origin page call — not a credential-less server-side loopback.
